messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: Smart routing anomaly detected in prod (us-east-1). Cost-based policy 'economy-v2' deviated: 63% traffic -> tiny-quant-128 (low-quality). Alerting: increased customer complaints + eval regressions. Severity: P1
ben_oncall: 👋 on it. acked. pulling traces and rollout windows now.
alice_sre: seeing error spike in quality checks (synthetic prompts failing regtests). RTT ok, token counts normal.
dmitri_ml: confirmed tiny-quant-128 has higher hallucination rate on safety prompt set vs stable: 18% -> 46%. definitely a quality regression.
carla_product: we've got customer support thread from two large customers complaining about nonsense outputs in search summaries. flagging potential user impact.
ben_oncall: timeline: at 16:07 cost-policy optimizer pushed economy-v2 to 40% traffic as an experiment, by 16:12 a cascade pushed it to 63% due to regional capacity signal.
ben_oncall: trying quick mitigation: pin routing to stable variants for affected routes. applying emergency override.
deploy-bot: @ben_oncall started rollout: policy-override (emergency) -> set route fallback to stable-1b across us-east-*.
ben_oncall: runbook step 1: disable cost-led autoscale for economy-v2. runbook step 2: emergency route override. executing now.
ben_oncall: exec: ```
# temp override to route all chat completions to stable-1b
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood/api/v1/routing/override \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"selector":"prod:us-east-*","variant":"stable-1b","expiry":"+30m","reason":"emergency quality mitigation"}'
```
alice_sre: logs show fallback loop between us-east-1 and us-east-2 when tiny-quant slots exhausted -> double routing attempts. that explains surge. we should disable cross-region fallback while we stabilize.
dmitri_ml: disabling cross-region fallback for economy-v2 now. command: `adminctl routes update economy-v2 --cross-region-fallback=false`
deploy-bot: route update applied. cross-region-fallback=false for economy-v2 in prod.
ben_oncall: monitoring metrics. quality alerts dropping after override?
alice_sre: synthetic eval success rate climbed from 52% -> 89% within 90s of override. latency stable.
jess_support: pinging impacted accounts with initial notification: "we're investigating quality regressions, temporary routing changes in place, will follow up". Customer A assigned to me.
carla_product: need a triage note for CSMs and a postmortem tag if customers escalate. I'll draft an external note.
dmitri_ml: root cause hypothesis: economy-v2 optimizer mis-evaluated tiny-quant-128 on short-run cost metric; missed recent regtests added last week. optimizer treated recent capacity signals as signal to favor cheapest variant without new eval weights.
ben_oncall: temp mitigation checklist done. next: rollback the experimental promotion of economy-v2 to pre-incident config and lock the optimizer until we patch scoring.
ben_oncall: rolling back optimizer commit 0a9f3e -> set policy weights to previous baseline.
deploy-bot: optimizer rollback succeeded. economy-v2 weights restored.
alice_sre: can we add a guardrail: don't route >30% to variants lacking current evals or failing recent regsets? we should create a hard guard in the router.
dmitri_ml: agreed. I'll open a PR to require recency check on model eval metadata in routing decisions. tagging @alice_sre for test plan.
carla_product: Ops question: how long until we can safely re-enable cost-led routing? want to balance cost vs trust.
dmitri_ml: need a few things: (1) patch to optimizer scoring, (2) run full regtest suite + a holdout eval set for tiny variants, (3) 1h canary at 5% with alerting. estimate ~4-6 hours.
ben_oncall: for now set manual policy: cost-led disabled globally for chat-completions.
ben_oncall: `adminctl policy set cost-led-enabled=false --scope=chat-completions` -> applied.
jess_support: updated the two affected customers with ETA 4-6h, offered workaround (pin to dedicated model variant).
carla_product: good. include note: customers with strict quality SLAs should be moved to dedicated/stable-variants. we'll follow up with account teams.
ben_oncall: handing off to @alice_sre for post-incident monitoring and infra follow-up. I'm off in 20m, will remain reachable.
alice_sre: taking over. will maintain watch for next 6 hours and coordinate with dmitri for optimizer patching.
alice_sre: adding timeline to incident doc: root cause, mitigation actions, customer impact, follow-ups (guardrail, optimizer tests, runbook update).
dmitri_ml: created GH issue: #1123 "optimizer: evaluate recency + regtest gating for variant promotion". assigning self and alice_sre.
ben_oncall: quick note for postmortem: include traffic histogram, model eval deltas, exact rollout commits, and why cross-region fallback allowed bounce.
alice_sre: also add runbook change: during cost-policy experiments, require manual approval for >30% promotions for variants without 7-day regtest pass.
jess_support: I logged support tickets and added customer's severity notes. will provide transcripts to product after this call.
carla_product: once we have draft postmortem I'll prepare customer-facing communication.
ben_oncall: great work team. closing pager -> monitor until overnight stable.
incident-bot: Pager cleared by ben_oncall at 16:13:45. Incident status: mitigated. Follow-ups: optimizer patch, routing guardrail, runbook update, customer comms.
alice_sre: noted. I'll keep thread open for updates and will post the postmortem link here when available.
carla_product: thanks all. :heart:
